scope: standalone complete BF16 activation quantize plus FP8 target gate-up matmul at exact N34816/K5120 for T5 and T6

numeric.oracle: independent BF16-source E4M3 quantization plus complete represented-E4M3 FP64 dot formula

limitations: does not establish whole-DFlash performance, exact-token parity, or production eligibility
